run.name: sax1-340M-fwe15B-74b227a9
run.purpose: SAX series opener: Muon(polar-express) + qk-norm + z-loss + fitted-law lr at the 340M/15B benchmark coordinate — first recipe verdict vs the tpp baseline
run.hardware: 1 node x 4x A100-SXM4-40GB (MPCDF Raven, partition gpu)

recipe: recipe/train/sax1_340M_fwe15B.yaml at the commit — delta vs tpp baseline: muon (lr 1.75e-3 shared via lr_adjust rms, polar-express NS), linear 1%->0.05 (was cosine 3e-4/0.1), z_loss 1e-4, wd 0.1 (was 0.01), qk_norm on, micro 16 + liger CE (baseline ran micro 8 + full fp32 CE)
lr_selection: fitted law adam_lr = 0.087571*tokens^-0.3461*hidden^-0.3448*sqrt(tpb) -> 1.75e-3 @ (15e9, 1024, 524288). 1B pilots (loss_ce tail5): lr10 2.8378, lr17 2.8037, lr30 2.7909 — monotone to 3e-3, consistent with the law's 1B optimum ~4.5e-3; 15B value kept per the law (user decision: trust the horizon exponent).

data.note: first run on the migrated home-GPFS layout (2026-08-29, no ptmp symlinks) and first with the prefetch loader (298b37e)
data.shards: 000_00000.npy .. 013_00009.npy (140 shards, one per source parquet; full witnessed list in the run's meta.json)

results.verdict: loss_ce 2.4007 vs tpp baseline tail5 2.5259 — -0.125 nat at matched data/order/budget; roughly a 1.7-2.5x token-equivalent advantage (exact multiplier depends on the irreducible-loss estimate). Baseline's final loss was reached by ~9B tokens mid-flight.
results.health: zero instability events across 28610 steps: gnorm max 0.79 post-warmup (clip 1.0 never fired), attn_logit_max capped ~25-27 flat (qk-norm), z-term 0.015->0.0009 monotone, pnorm/embedding arc 140->434(step 8000)->314 (wd-0.1 equilibrium then decay-tracking; baseline grew monotonically 114->225), upd_ratio muon-vs-decay groups within ~15% all run (shared-lr rms design validated).
